notes:
This update covers everything since 1.41.13.

On a PC whose Windows uses a comma as the decimal mark, the figures your bots post could be misread on the way in, so a city might show a fraction of what it really held. Every number the app reads now uses one fixed format regardless of the Windows language.

Restarting or logging off Windows can no longer catch the database mid-write: the journal is folded first, before anything else shuts down.

The Activity row in the sidebar now carries a red count of unread problems, and a Problems filter on that page lists just those. Four settings that could fail to save without a word now say so there too.

Ctrl+K finds every page, including the ones hidden from the sidebar. The Alerts page no longer calls the fleet healthy when the alerts were merely snoozed or dismissed, the Dashboard explains an empty Active table, and the Bots page shows auto-launch progress again.

In Alert Rules, picking an account loads the override it already has and saving one value no longer deletes the others. The Resource and Hero threshold cards on Settings say when their alert type is switched off. Auto backup and the tray options are proper switches, and changing the backup keep count no longer wipes a custom folder.

Plus a handful of small corrections: the Scripts page card count, the Activity log trimming itself sooner, the Flash storage lock checking the file itself, and the WebView2-missing message naming the right port.
